title: The doctor who asked for clean hands

probes.question: What did Semmelweis propose in 1847 at Vienna General Hospital?
options: Hand washing with chlorinated lime solutions

probes.question: True or false: the germ theory of disease had been accepted in Vienna when Semmelweis started.

image.alt: A black-and-white engraved portrait of Ignaz Semmelweis in profile, a bald man with a moustache and bow tie
image.credit: After Jenő Doby's engravig / Wikimedia Commons

panels.text: Vienna General Hospital, 1840s. Childbed fever was common in the 19th century, and often fatal.
Ignaz Semmelweis noticed that doctors' wards had thrice the mortality of midwives' wards.
In 1847, he proposed hand washing with chlorinated lime solutions at the First Obstetrical Clinic.
The maternal mortality rate dropped from 18% to less than 2%. His ideas were rejected by the medical community at the time.
